$description: The Tin Road design tokens — machine-readable mirror of tokens.css. Palette 'fired clay' from docs/art-direction.md. Rule zero: pigment does not glow — no shadows, gradients, blur, or emissive effects anywhere.

kiln.role: warnings, refusals, seals, borders that mean it

chronicle.value: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif

rules: Pigment does not glow: never use box-shadow, text-shadow, gradients, blur, or opacity fades for emphasis.
Every surface gets a drawn contour line; emphasis comes from line weight and pigment, not elevation.
The chronicle is the centerpiece: serif, generous leading, selectable, never truncated with ellipsis.
Kiln red is spent, not decorated with: refusals, seals, and dangerous acts only.
Interfaces attempt and report: buttons stay enabled, and refusals are stated in words, in kiln red.
The tiled geometric border (meander) marks major pieces only — one per view.
Writing depicted in ornament is asemic: patterns may suggest script, never spell anything.
